nodes.description: msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for authorization, allowances and balance accounting
address private owner; privileged account assigned in the constructor and used by all require(msg.sender==owner) checks
mapping(address=>uint) public balanceOf; user balances mutated without SafeMath in transferFrom/batchSend
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) public allowance; spend approvals, decremented unchecked in transferFrom
mapping(address=>uint256) private _onSaleNum; per-address sale counter incremented on every transfer
mapping(address=>bool) private canSale; per-address sale whitelist consulted by ensure()
uint256 private _minSale; minimum accepted transfer amount enforced in condition()
uint256 private _maxSale; maximum accepted transfer amount enforced in condition()
uint256 private _saleNum; maximum number of sales allowed per address
address tradeAddress; privileged address whitelisted inside ensure()
uint public totalSupply; total token supply set in constructor
string public name of the token
string public symbol of the token
address constant UNI = 0x7a250d5630B4cF539739dF2C5dAcb4c659F2488D; hardcoded router address whitelisted in ensure()
constructor(string _name, string _symbol, uint256 _supply) payable: mints supply to msg.sender, sets owner and an unlimited allowance for the UNI address
transfer(address _to, uint _value) public payable: forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) public payable: allowance check, ensure() gate, unchecked balance mutations and _onSaleNum increment
ensure(address _from,address _to,uint _value) internal view: whitelist gate (owner / UNI / pairFor address / tradeAddress / canSale) else condition()
approve(address _spender, uint _value) public payable: writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
condition(address _from, uint _value) internal view: enforces _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits
delegate(address a, bytes memory b) public payable: owner-only low-level delegatecall with arbitrary target and calldata
init(uint256 saleNum, uint256 token, uint256 maxToken) public: owner-only configuration of _minSale/_maxSale/_saleNum with unchecked scaling
batchSend(address[] _tos, uint _value) public payable: owner-only loop crediting balances with unchecked arithmetic
setTradeAddress(address addr) public: owner-only setter of the whitelisted tradeAddress
pairFor(address factory,address tokenA,address tokenB) internal pure: computes the Uniswap pair address from a hardcoded init code hash
low-level a.delegatecall(b) inside delegate(): executes attacker-supplied code in this contract's storage context
unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom (Solidity 0.5, no SafeMath, can underflow)
unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom (no SafeMath, can overflow)
unchecked arithmetic in batchSend: uint total = _value * _tos.length and balanceOf mutations
unchecked arithmetic in init: token*(10**uint256(decimals)) and maxToken*(10**uint256(decimals))
local _UNI = pairFor(...) pair address computed in ensure()
